description: Ask your human before a risky or irreversible step (deploying, paying, deleting, emailing real people). Emails the workspace owner a link; only a signed-in workspace owner or admin can answer. Returns an id and answerUrl (show it in chat too), then call wait_for_approval. Needs an approved workspace key.

summary.description: Optional review context. Omit secrets and raw arguments.

target.description: Human-readable target such as production or release 1.2.

details.description: Optional context: what will happen, diff summary, cost.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this key when retrying the same proposed action.

question.description: One clear question, up to 500 characters.

name: ask_human
